signature.name: VTask.insertIdx
signature.type: {α : Type u_1} -> {n : ℕ} -> (a : α) -> (i : Fin (n + 1)) -> (v : List.Vector α n) -> List.Vector α (n + 1)

conventions.statement: When the insertion index is 0 (the smallest `Fin (n+1)` value), the element `a` is placed at the front and every original element shifts one position to the right.
When the insertion index equals `n` (the largest valid `Fin (n+1)` value), the element `a` is appended after all existing elements, leaving their positions unchanged.
conventions.note: Equivalent to append/snoc at the tail.

facts.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (a : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) (v : List.Vector ℕ n), (VTask.insertIdx a i v).toList.length = n + 1
